card.name: Start of drug names beginning with V
card.fires_on: The first letter v or V that begins a drug name such as velpatasvir, vardenafil, valsartan or vincristine, mostly in drug-interaction lists. It also fires on a few other word starts like 'a' or 'equiv'.

modes.label: V starting a drug name
modes.description: A lone v or V that opens a drug name in an interaction list or after a sentence break.
modes.example: Ritonavir (600 mg b.i.d.) co-administered with<< v>>ardenafil hydrochloride tablets 5

modes.label: Other word starts
modes.description: Occasional non-drug word starts in running prose or toxicology text.
modes.example: Dr. JoAnne Putnam gave<< a>> presentation titled Teacher Education Program Models for In
